columns.name: PORTRAIT_CONTENT_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key

columns.name: PORTRAIT_CONTENT_ITEM_KEY
columns.description: A keyword provided as name of a Portrait Card or Card Region in Portrait Settings page.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: PORTRAIT_CARD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Portrait content item is a card or not

columns.name: PARENT_CONTENT_ITEM_KEY
columns.description: Indicates which Portrait card the content item belongs to

columns.name: ALLOW_USER_CONTROL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the user is allowed to control preferences for this content item

columns.name: DEFAULT_MANAGER_VISIBLE
columns.description: Indicates whether the selected card is by default visible to the Manager or not, while viewing Portrait of the Employee in manager hierarchy.

columns.name: DEFAULT_CONNECTIONS_VISIBLE
columns.description: Indicates whether the selected card is by default visible in Portrait to the Connections in the network or not.

columns.name: DEFAULT_EVERYONE_VISIBLE
columns.description: Indicates whether the selected card is by default visible in Portrait to every or not.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DISPLAY_CARD_IN_PORTRAIT
columns.description: indicates whether the card should be displayed on the portrait page

columns.name: CARD_ORDER
columns.description: Number of the card in the user customised card order

columns.name: PORTRAIT_CARD_NUMBER
columns.description: Default number of the card in the portrait

columns.name: PORTRAIT_ADMIN_FLAG
columns.description: indicates whether the card should be visible only to the user with administrator previleges

columns.name: DEFAULT_CARD
columns.description: indicates whether the card is a default card to be displayed

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
